notes:
# BondoMod v0.2.13

- Fix recognition of a default boost (product 0) when the local preset is sufficiently identified. Previously this could reject the entire loadout and prevent other items from being restored.
- Restore simultaneous resets of boost and optional cosmetics on a verified local loadout, including White Hat and Dev Boost regression coverage.
- A default boost in the unused team preset no longer blocks correction of the selected preset. Preserve the other preset and reject foreign channels or insufficient ownership evidence.
- Add precise recognition diagnostics: candidate channel, validated slot count, rejected slot/product, rejection reason and expected/observed cosmetic IDs. Unknown values remain explicitly unrecognized.
- Automatically send a limited diagnostic when a later item reset correction was successfully forwarded, as well as for existing recognition and delivery failures. Preserve current match/session information during frequent corrections; keep offline retries, rate limits and the existing opt-out.

The reproduced decoder cases pass automated tests. The reported White Hat and Dev Boost resets still need confirmation on the affected PC; their previous reports did not contain the rejected product value. Owned RLCS / Esports decals may still reset spawned item colours after a goal.
